title: Crop Scouting Vendor Form
subtitle: Crop Scouting capture supplier identity, qualification evidence, capability, record delivery, risk conditions, approval terms, and periodic review ownership.
description: An original, workflow-complete crop scouting vendor review covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use when evaluating or renewing a vendor whose products or services affect the named farm or food workflow and require documented conditions and escalation. The record is owned by the crop management owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Crop Scouting vendor review routing
sections.guidance: Identify the vendor, category, subject, and review owner.

blocks.label: Vendor Review identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Crop Scouting vendor review scope
blocks.guidance: Define the operating scope that this review may approve, condition, or exclude.

sections.title: Crop Scouting vendor identity and qualification
sections.guidance: Capture evidence for review without claiming certification.

blocks.label: Crop Scouting qualification evidence
items: Crop, region, and scouting-service scope are defined
Scout experience and qualified-review pathway are documented
Sampling methods and route coverage are described
Trap, photo, map, and specimen data formats are identified
Diagnostic laboratory and chain-of-custody process is described
Threshold sources and recommendation boundaries are explicit
Turnaround times and urgent finding escalation are documented
Data ownership, privacy, correction, and retention are reviewed
Field access, biosecurity, and incident contacts are identified

sections.title: Crop Scouting vendor document review
sections.guidance: Track each item, reviewer, expiry or refresh point, and gap.

blocks.label: Vendor record controls
items: Vendor identity and contacts match submitted evidence
Document source, date, reviewer, and refresh point are recorded
Product or service scope matches the proposed crop scouting use
Expired, missing, or conditional evidence remains visible
Corrections preserve the original record, reason, and responsible person
Required records can be delivered in the agreed format and timing

sections.title: Crop Scouting capability and service levels
sections.guidance: Compare promised capability with evidence and operating constraints.

blocks.label: Seasonal capacity, dependencies, substitutions, and service limitations

sections.title: Crop Scouting vendor decision
sections.guidance: Document approval scope, conditions, review frequency, and authority.

blocks.label: Vendor decision basis
items: Crop Scouting qualification evidence matches the proposed scope
Capacity, response, substitutions, and dependencies were reviewed
Required records and escalation contacts can be delivered
Approval conditions, exclusions, and monitoring are explicit
Authorized reviewer assigned the status and renewal point

blocks.label: Approved scope, conditions, exclusions, monitoring, and renewal triggers

sections.title: Crop Scouting vendor exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Keep expired evidence, performance gaps, and conditional work visible.

blocks.label: Vendor-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not certify a vendor or replace qualified crop scouting judgment. Approval is limited to the documented scope, conditions, evidence, and review period. Hold new or changed work and escalate missing evidence, substitutions, performance concerns, or decisions outside the reviewer’s authority.

blocks.label: Crop Scouting vendor exception triggers
items: Required vendor evidence is missing, expired, or unverifiable
Proposed scope or capacity does not match the crop scouting need
Product, part, method, or subcontractor substitution lacks review
Required operational records cannot be delivered or corrected
Performance, complaint, incident, or corrective-action concern is open
Approval authority, condition, insurance, or applicable review is pending

blocks.label: Gap, immediate safeguard, vendor response, owner, due point, and disposition

sections.title: Crop Scouting vendor record closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer conditions, monitoring, renewal, and evidence ownership.

blocks.label: Crop Scouting open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Crop Scouting handoff confirmations
items: Approved scope, conditions, and exclusions were recorded
Missing or expiring evidence has an owner and refresh date
Monitoring, performance review, and renewal points were assigned
Vendor and internal escalation contacts received the handoff
Crop Scouting vendor evidence and decision record were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
